description: Small hand-validated sentence label set for the decision/action classifier. Labels: 0=other, 1=decision, 2=action. Provenance: every sentence was written and labelled BY HAND by the project author while building this repository (NOT model-generated, NOT rule-generated). It is a validation aid for a college mini project, not a benchmark; its size (30 sentences) is far too small for training, so training still uses documented rule-based weak labels over QMSum.
